name: world-sync-extras
author: Lil Art
description: World Sync's playable content and extras. The Jormungandr saga: Episode 20 (The Undying One) and Episode 21 (Age of Heroes) with full dialogue, the official quest steps, memorial dungeons, dailies and the Ice Castle and Lunaforma traders. The official NPCs whose logic no server data has yet, placed where the clients put them. Optional entrances into the World Sync maps, and @npcplace to move NPCs. Needs Ragnarok Offline 1.6.7 or later.

settings.label: Jormungandr saga: Episodes 20 and 21
settings.description: Episode 20 starts from Horuru in the Ice Castle (Episode 19 done, level 200+); Episode 21 from Voglinde in the Ice Castle's west wing (level 230+). Includes the memorial dungeons, the dailies and the traders and enchanters. Turned off, its NPCs leave the Jormungandr maps entirely (their placeholders don't come back).

settings.label: Varmundt, Amatsu, Juno Library and Chapter 1
settings.description: CI test only: the setting is the main session's to add.

settings.label: Jormungandr: start Episode 20 without Episode 19
settings.description: Horuru offers Episode 20 to any character of level 200 or more, even one that hasn't finished Issgard's Episode 19 story.

settings.label: Entrances into the World Sync maps
settings.description: 34 portals from towns and fields into Biosphere, Jormungandr, Chapter 2 and other maps World Sync fills. Only turn this on if your client has those maps (recent iRO/kRO data): without them the game hangs on the loading screen.

settings.label: Place the official NPCs that have no logic yet
settings.description: 467 NPCs from the official clients' maps and signboards. 44 of them already work (storage, guild storage, inns, repair, channel switches, the Varmundt elevator, Jormungandr's contact points, market guides); the rest greet you until their quests and services are written.

settings.label: @npcplace: move NPCs in game (GM)
settings.description: Stand next to an NPC and type @npcplace to move it where you stand or nudge it; the spot is kept across restarts. @npcplace list shows what you moved.
